verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy is a fair question for an orchestration framework and platform like Dagster, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a changelog with feature updates, but nothing on API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. A changelog alone is an adjacent artifact and does not establish versioned APIs or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
